risk_levels.R0: Read-only audit and local tests with minimized output
risk_levels.R1: Verified reversible local code/fixture edits within scope
risk_levels.R2: Sensitive change preparation only: flags off, dry-run, migration and rollback
risk_levels.R3: Production effects require explicit scoped approval

approval_required_for: live URL redirects or slug changes
existing scoring or result meaning changes
additional personal data or tracking collection
ad account settings or publisher changes
new paid services or external model calls
safe_autofix_preconditions: source of the correct value is verified
no protected meaning, privacy, indexing or production setting change
regression test exists and was executed
forbidden_git_actions: unapproved stash or overwrite of user changes
